notes.title: Smoother game launch preparation
notes.body: Starting the game no longer leaves the launcher unresponsive while it prepares the Route 7 event-ready game copy or your selected field character. Preparation runs in the background, and errors return the launcher to a usable state with a clear message. This launcher reliability update keeps your original game file and saves.

notes.body: The launcher now checks that the presence relay matches its release and supports the location updates needed by Teleport. When an outdated relay is still running from this installation, **Check relay** or **Host presence relay here** restarts it automatically. If the relay runs on another computer or was started outside this installation, update and restart it on the host before reconnecting.

notes.body:
- Fixed a crash that could happen when opening a PokÃ© Martâ€™s buy list. Mega Stones are split between alternating Marts, so all 49 remain available across Unova without overcrowding any one shop. Each stone costs â‚½50,000.

notes.title: PokÃ©mon Center crash fix and launcher reliability
notes.body:
- Fixed a crash when entering a PokÃ©mon Center.
- Cynthia is available through Practice rematches without the unsupported-trainer error.
- Updates and launcher repair handle damaged or incomplete setup information more safely. A failed update can be retried without replacing the current game.

- Problem reports better hide network addresses and authorization information.
